positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Proposed, designed, and implemented several key strategies in larger team-wide initiative to migrate our Maps shape-rendering strategy from SVG to Canvas
  ⁃ Authored performant shape hit-detection system for canvas-drawn map shapes, supporting hover/select/edit interactions without relying on DOM elements. Used intelligent prioritization and custom heuristics to identify the most relevant shape under cursor, even in high-overlap scenarios.
  ⁃ Improved canvas rendering performance by removing reliance on SVG viewBox and implementing smooth pan/zoom behavior using efficient CSS transforms. Ensured seamless shape editability with dynamic fallback to SVG during drag interactions.

• Shipped Compass Maps library suite, enabling standardized map behavior (drawing, editing, searching) and visual theming across Compass apps.  Abstracted complex Maps state-management, including shape/pin/cluster rendering and editing, and exposed events via state-reducer pattern to allow Maps library consumers to hook custom logic to any Maps action

• Led infrastructure work to implement and standardize pnpm workspaces across frontend repos, a novel departure from our package-based infrastructure.  This improved cross-package reliability, enabled workspace-wide CI, and dramatically simplified tooling and version management across Compass packages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Co-led rewrite of Consumer Search with a focus on reliability, speed, and modern architecture. Owned the Free Draw and Saved Search integration experience.

• Reduced client-side search error rate by over 50% by implementing middleware to gracefully retry requests to flaky backend services. Validated success with DataDog traces and improved on-call quality of life.

• Tech lead for Listing Page v2, improving page load time 5× via smarter lazy loading and bundle analysis.  Owned core components like the Gallery and a custom ScrollLoader that deferred loading of heavy below-the-fold content, including an embedded Google Map, for significantly faster initial render.

• Boosted frontend test culture by increasing test coverage of Listing Editor from 0 to 2145 tests, driving adoption of unit testing practices during a time when they were not widely enforced at Compass.

• Audited and overhauled Sentry error tracking for Consumer Search, reducing noise from 800+ issues to 25 actionable ones. Proposed and established Sentry dashboard maintenance as part of the on-call process, documented responsibilities, and trained team members.

• Improved observability with better Sentry + FullStory integration, added deploy-aware metadata (release) and deduplication strategies to make crash triaging faster and more precise.

• Improved CI reliability by enforcing TypeScript compilation of e2e tests, catching broken test code at PR time instead of at deploy time.

• Enabled complex polygon support in backend search service, allowing users to draw and save self-intersecting or nested shapes without issue.
